name: MPC USB audio
author: jacob-sabella
summary: The MPC as a USB audio interface: its outputs and inputs as channels on the computer, next to its MIDI ports. Works where the device port is wired to the USB-B socket (Key 37 verified; One, One+). Not on the Force, Live II or X: their USB-B port sits behind the internal hub in standalone mode; use force-link-audio there.
